name: Flue Causeway
core_rationale: Western brass grating causeway of The Gilded Exhaust Flues at [0, 1] spanning the warm thermal vents between Verdigris Siphon and Bellows Hearth.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider couriers say the warm updrafts along Flue Causeway smell of roasted chestnuts and polished copper.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A riveted brass grating bridge suspended between two whistling golden smokestacks.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where does the western flue grating connect back to Patina Lock in Verdigris Siphon?

causal_continuity.evidence: Serves as the western entry causeway into The Gilded Exhaust Flues along scar-brass-faultline.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Riveted brass grating bridge suspended between whistling golden smokestacks and warm updrafts.
